title: Erase persisted hourly seen membership with witnessed cutoffs
scope: Remove erased visitor membership from persisted hourly seen state without losing proven post-cutoff membership; retain honest uncertainty for legacy entries with missing timestamps.
non_goals: No D03 cross-store transaction, D06 retention/re-entry policy, historical aggregate max-count correction/refold, all-destination erasure, customer/deployed/SLO/full-W06/finding/gate/release acceptance.

Keep version1 seen arrays with additive witnesses/uncertainty only. No new infrastructure, extra R2 reads, live decision-path changes, schema-wide migration, broad suite, external/cloud/customer-data operations, commit/push or subdelegation.

criteria.description: Every fold durably removes seen membership and its witness at/before the retained cutoff, including seen-only and replay/empty folds. Max witnessed same-brand/day timestamps preserve post-cutoff membership despite ring eviction. Orphan metadata/rings never create membership; unrelated subjects/brands/two non-default tenants and existing holdout behavior remain correct.

Legacy membership uses positive same-brand/day ring evidence only; missing timing is conservatively suppressed or rescued only by positive post-cutoff evidence, with persistent date-scoped per-brand uncertainty when legacy timing is incomplete. Propagate uncertainty to hour metadata/report counts.truncated; forward rollover clears all seen fields. Reject malformed/unreadable or older-date state before writing that shard and do not publish a successful hour aggregate; prior shards may have idempotent cleanup. Failed-put retries recover. Catch-up uses a typed newer-date refusal to skip definitely older candidates without I/O while keeping them failed/pending, preserves budget/maxHours/two genuine-failure limits, and reaches eligible current dates when budget allows.

Independent frozen source/proof review and exact single-fixture K1 verify actual persisted effects, witness/uncertainty semantics, compatible schema, no added R2 read/serving path and explicit historical/concurrency/performance limits; inspect worker compiler/scoped diff evidence. Inspect the one console incomplete-coverage string; no browser qualification is implied.

checks.runtime: Installed Node/Vitest, actual buildHour/foldShard/report with existing synthetic R2; no network.
checks.workload: One existing hourly fixture: inclusive cutoff, seen-only/replay persistence, post-cutoff/ring eviction, legacy uncertainty, tenant/brand boundaries, rollover/refusal/malformed state and failed-put retry; worker app noEmit/scoped diff. One concrete scheduler case covers two older missing hours ahead of eligible current work.

checks.command: Independent frozen W06.07 source and complete worker-proof review; exact K1 once, verify relevant pins and write review.json.
checks.runtime: Independent local actual-source review and synthetic R2 hourly fixture.
checks.workload: Review C1-C3 artifacts/semantics and focused runtime inputs; inspect worker compiler output without rerun. No broad or deployed qualification. Inspect existing console wording for the broader incomplete-coverage flag; no UI suite.

dependencies.consumed_output: Retained inclusive tenant/visitor tombstone semantics and strict loadTombstones.
dependencies.rationale: Reuse existing barrier lifecycle without renewing historical whole-task proof.
Per-fold cleanup is not a transaction with concurrent writers.
